title: Anthropic's S-1 excludes Labs co-lead Ben Mann from its "Continuing Founders" and Founder LLC; Anthropic says "it's still fair to refer to him as a co-founder" (Zara Stone/The San Francisco Standard)
summary: Zara Stone / The San Francisco Standard: Anthropic's S-1 excludes Labs co-lead Ben Mann from its “Continuing Founders” and Founder LLC; Anthropic says “it's still fair to refer to him as a co-founder” — On Oct. 14, Anthropic announced the opening of its first Singapore office and said “cofounder Ben Mann” …
contentText:
Zara Stone / The San Francisco Standard :

Anthropic's S-1 excludes Labs co-lead Ben Mann from its “Continuing Founders” and Founder LLC; Anthropic says “it's still fair to refer to him as a co-founder”   —  On Oct. 14, Anthropic announced the opening of its first Singapore office and said “cofounder Ben Mann” …
